# What your agent can do, and what you asked it to.

> An Agent Behaviour Policy writes down, for one agent in one deployment, everything it can reach, what you authorised it to do, the gap between the two, and what stands in the way of each thing. Eight panels, then the four words in a table. It describes and does not judge.

*Source: <https://customers.riskmandate.ai/what-is-an-abp/> · site v0.2.3 (2026-10-21) · this file is generated from the same content as the page, so the two cannot drift. Every page on this site has a `.md` twin; internal links below point at them.*

---

An **Agent Behaviour Policy**, an ABP, writes down, for one agent in one deployment, everything it can reach, what you authorised it to do, the gap between the two, and what stands in the way of each thing. It describes and does not judge, so it carries no score.
